mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate, indicative of accommodative monetary policy, reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that increases recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rates (below 0.1%) and low unemployment (below 4.5%) indicates a strong monetary policy support coupled with a resilient labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with labor market resilience
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and UNRATE < 4.5%, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-pandemic recovery regime, rising housing starts (HOUST) and positive GDP growth (GDPC1) signal strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1000 and GDPC1 growth is positive, or the joint signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1000, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a job market recovery regime, strong monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) exceeding 100,000 jobs signals improving labor conditions and rising consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 jobs during a job market recovery regime, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low CPIAUCSL index (below 240) and low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS below 0.1%) indicates a stable monetary environment that supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL < 240 and FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
